zones.name: Custer Co Plains, Pennington Co Plains
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the very high category this afternoon. Very poor weather conditions and very low moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that dangerous burning conditions exist. Fires will spread rapidly and show erratic behavior. Outdoor burning is not recommended.

zones.name: Harding, Northern Perkins, Butte, Northern Meade Co Plains, Ziebach, Rapid City, Haakon, Northern Oglala Lakota, Bennett, Southern Meade Co Plains, Hermosa Foothills, Southern Oglala Lakota, Southern Jackson, Southern Perkins
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the high category this afternoon. Unfavorable weather conditions and low moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that there is high potential for a fire to spread. Outdoor burning should be restricted to early morning or evening hours when wind speeds are usually lower and the relative humidity is higher.

zones.name: Northern Foothills, Southern Foothills, Western Fall River, Northern Jackson, Mellette, Todd, Tripp, Sturgis/Piedmont Foothills, Eastern Fall River
zones.description: The grassland fire danger index will reach the moderate category this afternoon. Marginal weather conditions or a lowering moisture content of grasses, and other dry organic material on the ground, indicate that there is some potential for a fire to spread. Any outdoor burning should be closely monitored.
